title: Ex-Google Recruiter Explains: Why "The Hidden Job Market" Is A Trap
description:
Get my Job Seekers Toolkit: https://stan.store/farahsharghi/p/get-my-job-seekers-toolkit-now
 Book a 1:1: https://stan.store/farahsharghi/p/book-a-1hour-career-coaching-session-with-me-eq3bs

The "hidden job market" is one of the biggest lies being sold to job seekers right now.

You've seen the stat, 80% of jobs are never posted. You need to network harder. Cold-message strangers. Pay someone to plug you into the secret market.

It's nonsense. And I'm going to show you exactly why.

I spent over a decade recruiting at Google, TikTok, Uber, Lyft, and The New York Times. In this video, I'm walking you through where that 80% stat actually came from (spoiler: it's older than the internet), the three real situations where a job isn't posted publicly, who those situations actually apply to, and what you should be doing instead of chasing headhunters who aren't looking for you.

By the end, you'll stop wasting energy on a market that doesn't exist the way career coaches say it does, and you'll know exactly where to put that energy instead.
